final_message: Fixed: `cp`’s path argument lacked variadic arity, so Zsh offered file completion only for the first operand. Added `.num_args(1..)` to support source and destination completion, plus a regression test. All 262 applicable `cp` tests pass; seven environment-dependent failures also occur without the fix.
